free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to the PI-RADS 5 lesion and a rising PSA velocity of 1.15 ng/mL/yr. This is supported by the high csPCa predicted probability of 0.8631027 and the prior positive biopsy status, which mandates re-evaluation. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved evidence of high-risk imaging features and rapid PSA progression overrides this initial suggestion.
